title: FC 5802: Definitions
officialText:
5802.1 Definitions.

The following terms shall, for the purposes of this chapter and as used elsewhere in this code, have the meanings set forth in FC 202.

FLAMMABLE GAS.

FLAMMABLE LIQUEFIED GAS.

GASEOUS HYDROGEN.

HYDROGEN FUEL GAS ROOM.

METAL HYDRIDE.

METAL HYDRIDE HYDROGEN STORAGE SYSTEM.

MICROTURBINE.
